name: Kumamoto

flag.description: A white ring with a flat side at the hoist, on a dark red field: the katakana ク (ku) drawn as the island of Kyūshū.
flag.symbolism: ク is the first sound of Kumamoto, and the shape is Kyūshū, with the hole marking Kumamoto at its heart.

hook: Kumamoto's white ク (ku) on dark red is also the outline of Kyūshū, with a hole where Kumamoto sits.
trivia: Mount Aso has one of the largest volcanic calderas in the world.
Kumamon, the black bear mascot, is Kumamoto's best-known ambassador.
